version: CP-IF09 / IF10, P2-05, P3-01 first locked pass

space.rule: All source frames and independent geometry/HSV/luma for selected refs. Distinct durable multi-view refs chosen without filenames, labels or old timing. X = first persistent B-specific geometric support after a gap (can co-exist with A; difference means this reference support root, not physical exclusivity) (retain shared separately and later episodes); last A is a different timestamp; no X equals no measurable evidence, not absence. X2 uses same roots/time plus a tight neighborhood for observed vertical structures with distinct-fit/heldout keypoint transfer and detected line confirmation; candidates do not certify a doorway. X3 checks independent repeated visual alignment when possible; physical R,p,delta and Y remain unknown without common calibration. Equal-root single side versus both use same references/data; no duplicated evidence votes.

p2.rule: V/Uniform/S2, then preserve S2/available low-level event role and add corroborated temporal roles/state charts; K is reversible marginal non-semantic role coverage, with spatial/temporal coverage and duplicate rollback only; no semantic identity/importance sums. S3 independent appearance vs continuity/relations on controlled visible fixtures and frozen existing candidate observations when comparable. Qchain independent query-ablation; never hard-code truth times. Optional text engines only if installed.

p3.budget: small live smoke only; four initial equal 8-image arms on old development source, at most two source requests per observer, each >=0.2 and <=1.1s at 10fps and max8 selected, max 1 followup after actual reads. Fixed model/auth route, independent sessions, seeded opaque IDs, two independent method-blind scoring sessions when reachable.
p3.independent_final_trial: requires genuinely new blind inputs beyond same five files; never fabricate result or quote script as actual Agent

stop: one frozen run, no thresholds tuned, no old/default mutation, all failures and availability separate; OCR/ASR/metric geometry optional with blocker and next trigger
